AGENDA
  GLENDALE AUDIT COMMITTEE
  VIA TELECONFERENCE ONLY
 Meetings are broadcast live on Glendale TV, viewable on Spectrum Cable, channel 6, and AT&T U-
 verse, channel 99. Meetings are also streamed live in high definition (HD) on the city's webpage,
 glendaleca.gov/live, on YouTube.com/myglendale, and on Apple TV, Roku, and Amazon Fire devices
 using a free app called Screenweave and choosing “Glendale TV” from the menu. Meetings are also
 archived on the City Website for viewing anytime at glendaleca.gov/agendas. Call (818) 548-4013 for
 program schedules. DVDs of the proceedings are available for purchase in the City Clerk's Office.
 Audit Reports are available for viewing by clicking here.
 If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for assistance, please contact the
 Finance Department at (818) 548-2085, during regular business hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE MEETING LOCATION
 In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
 language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
 are available same-day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required for
 requests regarding sign language translation and Braille transcription services. All documents related
 to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and
 are public records, will be available for review in the Office of the City Clerk, 613 E. Broadway, RM
 110, Glendale, CA 91206.
 Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
 wish to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City
 Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090, at least 24 hours prior to the scheduled meeting. Please specify
 the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City provided interpreters is not
 required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak in their native language.
  JANUARY 27, 2022 AT 2:00 PM

To help slow the transmission of COVID-19, and protect the health and safety of the community, City
Council, as well as Board & Commission meetings, will continue to be closed to the public for in-person
attendance.
The public is encouraged to watch and participate from the safety of their homes to practice social
distancing. Meetings are broadcast live on Glendale TV, viewable on Spectrum Cable, channel 6, and
AT&T U-verse, channel 99. Meetings are also streamed live in high definition (HD) on the city's webpage,
glendaleca.gov/live, on YouTube.com/myglendale, and on Apple TV, Roku, and Amazon Fire devices
using a free app called Screenweave and choosing “Glendale TV” from the menu.
For public comments and questions during the meeting, call (818) 937-8100. Public comments on a
specific agenda item will be taken when that agenda item is discussed.
 1. ROLL CALL
2. BUSINESS AGENDA
  a. Report of Recording Secretary, re: Posting of Agenda
  The Agenda for the January 27, 2022 Audit Committee Meeting was posted on January 24,
  2022, on the bulletin board outside City Hall.
3. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items not a part of this agenda. Each speaker is allowed 3 minutes. The
  Committee may question or respond to the speaker but there will be no debate or decision.
  The Audit Committee Chair may refer the matter to staff for investigation and report.
4. APPROVAL OF MINUTES
  a. Minutes of the Audit Committee meeting held on July 29, 2021.
  b. Minutes of the Audit Committee meeting held on October 28, 2021.
5. ACTION ITEMS
6. REPORTS - INFORMATION
  a. Internal Audit Activity Report as of 12/31/2021 – Jessie Zhang, Internal Audit Manager
  b. Comprehensive Annual Financial Report and Report to the Audit Committee from

8. NEW BUSINESS
9. ADJOURNMENT

CITY OF GLENDALE
  AUDIT COMMITTEE MINUTES
  January 27, 2022

Due to the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic, social distancing requirements, and health
recommendations from LA County Public Health Department, this meeting was
conducted remotely.
1.  ROLL CALL: 2:00 PM
  Present: Zareh Amirian, Edmund Khashadourian, Rosevart Nazarian, Alejandro
  Parajon
2.  BUSINESS AGENDA:
  A. Posting of Agenda
  The Agenda for the Audit Committee meeting of January 27, 2022, was posted
  on January 24, 2022 on the Bulletin Board outside City Hall. It was also posted
  on the City’s website.

3.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  None.

4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

  A. Minutes of the Audit Committee meeting held on July 29, 2021

  The minutes for the Audit Committee meetings held on July 29, 2021 was
  approved with a date typo correction from “October 29, 2020” to “April 29, 2021”.

  Moved: Ed Khashadourian  Seconded: Rosevart Nazarian
  Vote as follows:
  Ayes: Ed Khashadourian, Rosevart Nazarian, Alex Parajon, Zareh Amirian
  Noes: None
  Absent: None
  Abstain: Rosevart Nazarian

  1
   B. Minutes of the Audit Committee meeting held on October 28, 2021

  Moved: Ed Khashadourian  Seconded: Rosevart Nazarian
  Vote as follows:
  Ayes: Ed Khashadourian, Rosevart Nazarian, Zareh Amirian
  Noes: None
  Absent: None
  Abstain: Alex Parajon

5.  ACTION ITEMS:

  There were no action items.

6.  REPORTS – INFORMATION:

  B. Comprehensive Annual Financial Report and Report to the Audit
  Committee from CliftonLarsonAllen LLP – Alwin De Leon, Finance
  Accounting Manager

  Alwin De Leon, Finance Accounting Manager, introduced the external auditor
  from CliftonLarsonAllen LLP.

  Daphnie Munoz, Principal, from CliftonLarsonAllen LLP, provided a summary of
  the results of the audit performed of the City’s financial statements for the period
  ending June 30, 2021. City staff and Ms. Munoz answered questions from the
  Committee members.

  A. Internal Audit Activity Report as of 12/31/2021 – Jessie Zhang, Internal
  Audit Manager

  Ms. Jessie Zhang, Internal Audit Manager, provided a report to the Audit
  Committee on the Internal Audit activity for the quarter ended on December 31,
  2021.
  Mr. Sameel Salim, Senior Internal Auditor, made a presentation on the Glendale
  Parking Facilities Agreement Audit. Mr. Salim answered questions from the
  Committee members.
  After the audit presentation, Ms. Zhang continued presenting the Internal Audit
  activity report for the quarter. She covered projects in progress, continuous
  audits, quarterly follow-up status on outstanding audit issues, and advisory
  services and answered questions from the Committee members.

  2
 7.  AUDIT COMMITTEE/STAFF COMMENTS:

  Chair Amirian paid a public tribute to the late Audit Committee member Mr. Vahik
  Satoorian. Chair Amirian also thanked and expressed his appreciation for
  Internal Audit and Finance staff for their work and professionalism in presenting
  information to various committees and public.
8.  NEW BUSINESS:

  None.

9.  ADJOURNMENT:

  Adjourned in memory of Vahik Satoorian

  Moved: Alex Parajon  Seconded: Ed Khashadourian

  Adjournment at 3:26 PM
